funds.name: iShares Core U.S. Aggregate Bond ETF
funds.blurb: Holds thousands of U.S. investment-grade bonds instead of stocks, so its price mainly reacts to interest-rate moves rather than stock-market swings, giving it a much lower beta than any equity fund on this list. Holds thousands of U.S. investment-grade bonds (Treasuries, corporates, mortgage-backed), with no stock exposure.

funds.name: Vanguard Dividend Appreciation ETF
funds.blurb: Only holds companies with a decade-plus streak of raising dividends, a quality screen that tends to select steadier, more established businesses, so the fund moves less than the market even though it's still 100% stocks. Holds large U.S. companies with at least 10 consecutive years of dividend increases, filtered for financial health.

funds.name: Vanguard Wellesley Income Fund
funds.blurb: Keeps roughly 60-65% of assets in investment-grade bonds and only 35-40% in dividend-paying stocks, so its price barely budges compared to a pure stock fund or an individual company's share price. A balanced fund holding about 60-65% investment-grade bonds and 35-40% dividend-paying stocks.

funds.name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust
funds.blurb: Owns a slice of all 500+ S&P 500 companies at once, so a bad day for one company barely dents the fund, unlike an individual stock where one earnings miss can swing the price double digits. Tracks all 500+ companies in the S&P 500, weighted by market cap, across every major U.S. sector.
funds.holdingsNote: Tracks all 500+ companies in the S&P 500, weighted by market cap, across every major U.S. sector.

funds.name: Vanguard 500 Index Fund Admiral Shares
funds.blurb: The mutual fund twin of an S&P 500 ETF: it owns the same 500-plus companies, so it moves almost exactly in line with the broad market and avoids the single-company risk that comes with owning one stock. Tracks the S&P 500 directly, holding roughly 500 large U.S. companies in the same proportions as the index.
funds.holdingsNote: Tracks the S&P 500 directly, holding roughly 500 large U.S. companies in the same proportions as the index.

funds.name: Fidelity Contrafund

Actively managed; the portfolio manager selects several hundred large-cap growth-oriented stocks, with heavy exposure to a few mega-cap tech names.

funds.name: Invesco QQQ Trust
